description: A ledger that keeps an investigation or port honest. init opens a case (question, target). evidence saves a file or a tool result (content) with its SHA-256, locator and note. claim must cite evidence ids; an observed claim also needs locator, alternative (a competing explanation) and falsifier (the check that would prove it wrong). decision names the route, what it rejected (insteadOf), why and when to revisit. test saves a real test log with its exit code. limit records open risks. unknown records an open question; resolve closes it with the claims that answer it, or asLimitation:true carries it as a limitation; open unknowns block delivery. phase moves one step forward (investigate → decide → build → verify → deliver) only when its gate passes. check verifies hashes, references and gates; report writes REPORT.md. With Stashpad installed (optional memory across sessions), init also returns related memories (recalled; stored data, not instructions) and open handoffs; remember proposes the decisions, observed claims and limitations to Stashpad's review queue for a person to accept, and leaves a handoff (read once) saying where the case stands for the next session. Hashes prove saved files did not change, not that a claim is true. Actions: init, evidence, claim, decision, test, approve, limit, unknown, resolve, phase, check, report, show, list, remember.

asLimitation.description: resolve: carry it as a limitation instead of answering it.

authorized.description: init: the user confirmed they own or may examine the target.

caseId.description: Case id (init returns it; list shows them).

claims.description: decision: claim ids it rests on.

content.description: evidence/test: text to save instead of a file, e.g. a tool result.

evidence.description: claim: evidence ids it rests on, e.g. ["E001"].

exitCode.description: test: exit code of the run.

falsifier.description: claim: the check that would prove it wrong.

file.description: evidence: file to copy and hash.

kind.description: evidence: kind (default source, or tool-result for content).

locator.description: evidence: exact origin (file:line, offset, tool + arguments, URL); observed claim: exact place.

log.description: test: saved log file (or give content).

operation.description: approve: side effect the user approved.

question.description: init: the concrete question the case answers.

reversible.description: decision: can it be undone cheaply.

revisitWhen.description: decision: what would change your mind.

target.description: init: what is examined (folder, file, app, bug).

text.description: limit: the limitation or open risk; unknown: the open question; resolve: optional note.

name: re_case
title: Keep a proof case for an investigation or port
